items.title: Shelly Berg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: I’m just looking at Tim because he knows that Cannonball is my guy.

ctx.x: It’s a long list. At the center of it all for me growing up was Oscar Peterson. That’s why it was so gratifying to do this album with Ray Brown and that big band tribute album, because that was the motivation. And there was a time I was even going back and forth, classical music, jazz music, what do I want to do. And in one kind of astounding week, Vladimir Horowitz came out of one of his retirements and played in Houston where I was living, and Oscar Peterson came through and did a solo recital in the same hall.…
I’m just looking at Tim because he knows that Cannonball is my guy.
